newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain stocks jump two percent as volume doubles.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain stocks jump two percent as volume doubles.

text.p: Trade on the Bahrain stock exchange surged in the week to Thursday on renewed investor interest in key stocks, pushing the index up over two percent.
The bourse said the index rose more than 32 points to 1,617.04 from 1,584.95 points the previous week in activity focused on banking and investment shares.
Around 15.5 million shares worth 3.6 million dinars ($9.5 million) changed hands this week, more than double the 7.6 million shares worth 1.67 million dinars traded a week earlier.
This week's turnover was the highest so far this year.
Shares of 27 of the 39 listed firms were dealt.
Some 1.61 million Investcorp shares worth 1.1 million dinars changed hands. It closed the week at $1.78, up two U.S. cents from a week earlier.
Over five million Bahrain Middle East Bank shares worth 574,546 dinars were dealt. It rose 11 fils to 120 fils.
Bahrain's market is open to nationals of the six Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Oman, Qatar, Bahrain, the United Arab Emirates and Kuwait. Some firms are also open to foreign investors.
